summary: Master safety communication strategies to lead high-performance teams, ensure ISO 45001 compliance, and reduce workplace incidents. Enroll today.
lede: Safety communication strategies for managers help turn complex health and safety information into clear, actionable guidance for daily operations. This five-day course focuses on engaging multi-generational teams, using digital reporting tools, and connecting safety policies with frontline execution. You will practice applying Behavior-Based Safety principles, delivering effective safety toolbox talks, managing communication during critical incidents, and developing safety KPIs and visual management boards. The course also covers AI-assisted safety analytics, psychological safety, and ways to encourage reporting, share lessons learned, and support measurable safety improvements.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for leaders who are responsible for the health and safety outcomes of their teams and must communicate complex risks to diverse stakeholders.
modules: Incident Communication and Root Cause Analysis
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 2 years of experience in a supervisory or management role. A basic understanding of workplace health and safety principles is required. Familiarity with ISO 45001 or similar safety management systems is recommended but not mandatory.
